column1: # Chuvadi shaping behaviour corpus (d.5, rule 5). Generated by running Chuvadi.Pdf.Text.Shaping 3.31.0 as a program (built from the v3.31.0 source tree, git tree 4bd7b538, identical to tag v3.31.0 at commit 21652de); data only.
# Baseline: 3.31.0, the behaviour users have now (D-182), including D-169 (cmap above U+FFFF and format 14 variation sequences).
# Fonts: the pack's fonts folder; WOFF2 unpacked with Chuvadi.Pdf.Fonts.Woff2 3.31.0. Language: the engine has no language argument; the fonts' default language system.
# Columns: category <TAB> script (LipiScript) <TAB> font file <TAB> input <TAB> features on <TAB> note <TAB> result.
# input: UTF-16 content as space-separated hex code points; a surrogate pair is written as its code point, an unpaired surrogate as its code unit followed by '!'; <empty> is "", <null> is null.
# features on: every switchable feature that is ON for that line, by tag (all others off); this is the complete set, independent of what ShapingFeatures.Default means.
# result: glyph:cluster:x-advance:x-offset:y-offset per glyph, font units, clusters as UTF-16 indices; or EXCEPTION <type>: <message>.
# Every line was shaped with both Shape(FontFace) and Shape(byte[]); the two results are identical on every line (checked while generating).
